copy.tagline: 用 Firebase 构建后端功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Firebase 开发应用后端。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing an app backend with Firebase.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 Firebase 模块化 SDK 帮你初始化 Firestore、Auth、Storage 等服务，并编写 CRUD、实时监听、安全规则、Cloud Functions v2 等代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 Firebase、Firestore、Authentication、Cloud Functions 等关键词，或要求实现后端功能（如用户登录、数据存储）时触发。

say.text: 写一个 Firestore 安全规则，只允许登录用户读写自己的文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Firebase modular SDK to help you initialize Firestore, Auth, Storage, and write CRUD, real-time listeners, security rules, Cloud Functions v2 code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Firebase, Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, or ask for backend features like user login or data storage.

say_en.text: Initialize Firestore and Auth with the modular Firebase SDK.
say_en.note: Claude generates initialization code and exports db and auth instances.

say_en.text: Write a Firestore security rule allowing only logged-in users to read/write their own documents.
say_en.note: Claude generates rules with auth checks.

say_en.text: Create a Cloud Functions v2 HTTP function that returns all published posts.
